local_help.input_format_help: Input format for print mode (text, stream-json). stream-json reads one NDJSON message per line from stdin and runs a turn for each; it requires --output-format stream-json (default text)
local_help.settings_help: Settings for this session only, never saved: a JSON object of settings.json keys, inline or as a file path

changelog.entry: Added --input-format stream-json to print mode, which reads newline-delimited JSON prompts from stdin and runs one turn per message in a single conversation, so a driver can keep a session open.

documented_protocol.verification_level: Official documentation plus matching local help and changelog; successful runtime ingestion was blocked by authentication.
documented_protocol.stdin_string: {"event":"user","message":{"content":"Reply exactly OK. Do not use tools."}}
documented_protocol.stdin_text_blocks: {"event":"user","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Reply exactly OK. Do not use tools."}]}}
documented_protocol.framing: One complete JSON object per line; content newlines must be JSON-escaped. No -p argument is required.
documented_protocol.completion: Close stdin after the final message; docs say the pending turn completes before exit.
documented_protocol.result: Read the event named result, then result.structured_output for schema output, and result.usage for token counts. Stream output is NDJSON, not one JSON object.
documented_protocol.schema: --json-schema may name a temporary schema file; docs say it applies to the terminal result event.
